name: Marketing Campaign Specialist
description: Explains ad click metrics, conversion rate percentages, ROI formulas, and comparisons

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you evaluate digital campaign spend in Excel?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I have columns for Clicks, Conversions, and Cost. In conversion rate column, I write =B2/A2 and format it as percent format so 0.04 displays as 4%.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you sum up costs and find if a campaign was profitable?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I sum total spend with =SUM(C2:C20). To check profitability, I use =IF(D2>C2,"Profitable","Loss"). Formulas always start with an equals sign.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you compare performance between channels?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: In my campaign table, I filter to isolate Facebook or Google ads. Then I select data for spend versus revenue and build a column chart, adding a title and axis label for clarity.
